title: Three bubbles placed on top of each other
question: Does the cluster now read as one shape, rather than as three circles crossing?
context_md:
Your first item: *"when you place multiple overlapping, they should merge instead of just looking like overlapping circles."*

Three circles placed so each cuts well into its neighbour, plus the one he is carrying. The only difference between the two panes is the merge rule — same three circles, same speed, same band depth — so nothing else here should move.

What changed underneath: each circle used to draw its own rim all the way round, including the stretch buried inside its neighbour. Now the rim is drawn on the edge of the *union*, so a bubble stops drawing where it is inside another one.

**The carried bubble is in both panes** (the warm one at his feet) and merges with the cluster the same way. The thin grey outline around him is the placement preview and is not part of this.

items.label: before
items.caption: each circle draws its own full rim

items.label: after
items.caption: the rim follows the edge of the union
